title: LAOYE Clothes Moth Traps 10 Pack Sticky Pheromone Moth Catchers for the Common Clothes Moth、Carpet Moths and Pale-Backed Clothes Moths Traps for Wardrobes, Clothes and Carpets
bullet_points: Protect Clothes from Clothes Moths: Clothes moth traps use targeted female pheromones to attract and capture common clothes moths such as webbing clothes moths, carpet moths and pale-backed moths, helping reduce breeding at the source and lowering the risk of fabric damage. Ideal for protecting wool, cashmere, knitwear and other natural fibres, as well as carpets and curtains. Not suitable for pantry moths or other household moth species.

Detect Moth Activity Early and Prevent Damage: Clothes moth traps help detect and monitor moth activity before visible damage occurs. Clothes moths are most active during warmer months, and infestations are often only noticed once fabrics are already damaged. Ideal for wardrobes and drawers storing seasonal clothing, helping ensure garments remain in good condition even after months in storage.

Child and Pet Friendly: Clothes moth traps offer a more suitable alternative to traditional mothballs and chemical sprays. Free from harsh chemicals and strong odours, they use pheromone attraction to target clothes moths while reducing impact on the home environment. Suitable for use in bedrooms, wardrobes and living spaces, making them a more reassuring option for households with children and pets.

Easy to Use: Clothes moth traps are simple to set up. Open the foil pouch, remove the trap, peel off the protective film and fold into shape, then place in wardrobes or storage areas. The pheromone is pre-infused into the adhesive layer, requiring no additional steps. Once placed, the trap begins attracting and capturing clothes moths immediately.

Suitable for Common Moth Areas: Clothes moth traps are designed for use in areas where moths are most likely to appear, such as wardrobes, drawers, carpets, curtains, upholstered furniture and storage boxes. Also suitable for use in knitwear shops, fabric stores and garment workshops containing natural fibres. Placing traps in these areas helps monitor activity and protect valuable fabrics.

Long-Lasting Protection: Clothes moth traps come in a pack of 10, with each trap lasting up to 3 months. Designed for continuous monitoring and control during peak moth season, they help reduce the need for frequent replacement while providing long-term protection for wardrobes, carpets and stored clothing.
description:
Clothes moth traps help protect natural fabrics from damage caused by clothes moths, especially during the warmer months when moth activity increases. These pheromone clothes moth traps attract and capture common clothes moth species such as Common Clothes Moths, Carpet Moths and Pale-Backed Clothes Moths, helping protect wool, cashmere and other natural fibre garments, as well as carpets, curtains and other textiles from moth damage. Please note these clothes moth traps are not suitable for pantry moths or other household moth species, so ensure the moths in your home are clothes moths before purchasing.

Summer is the peak breeding season for clothes moths, and many people only realise there is a problem once holes appear in clothing or carpets. Using pheromone clothes moth traps allows you to detect and monitor moth activity early, helping you take action before damage occurs. They are particularly useful for protecting seasonal clothing stored in wardrobes or drawers so garments remain in good condition when used again months later.

Unlike traditional mothballs or chemical sprays, these pheromone clothes moth traps offer a safer and more environmentally friendly way to control clothes moths. They are odourless, non-toxic and contain no harsh chemicals. By using pheromone attraction instead of pesticides, clothes moth traps can be safely used in wardrobes, bedrooms and living areas, making them suitable for homes with children and pets.

Clothes moth traps are simple to use. Just open the foil pouch, remove the clothes moth trap, peel off the protective film, fold the trap into shape and place it in wardrobes or clothing storage boxes. The pheromone lure is already infused into the adhesive surface so the clothes moth traps begin attracting and capturing moths as soon as they are placed.
